title: CLARA Care LifeMap Timeline Event Query Typed Contract

endpoints.summary: Longitudinal LifeMap timeline events query with bitemporal filtering, safe PHI DTO, and keyset cursor pagination

query_parameters.name: valid_time_from
query_parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on valid clinical time (occurred_at)

query_parameters.name: valid_time_to
query_parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on valid clinical time (occurred_at)

query_parameters.name: system_time_from
query_parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on system recorded time (recorded_at)

query_parameters.name: system_time_to
query_parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on system recorded time (recorded_at)

query_parameters.name: episode_id
query_parameters.description: Filter by associated care loop episode public ID

query_parameters.name: event_types
query_parameters.description: Filter by event categories (medication, symptom, condition, lab, vitals, visit, task, etc.)

query_parameters.name: truth_states
query_parameters.description: Filter by truth state (confirmed, user_reported, disputed, refuted, draft)

query_parameters.name: source_kinds
query_parameters.description: Filter by source origin kind (reported, clinical, extracted, iot, import)

query_parameters.name: search
query_parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search in event title and display summary

query_parameters.name: order_direction
query_parameters.description: Sort direction: desc (newest first) or asc (chronological)

query_parameters.name: cursor
query_parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor for keyset pagination

query_parameters.name: limit
query_parameters.description: Maximum items to return per page

query_parameters.name: offset
query_parameters.description: Offset fallback when cursor is not used

endpoints.summary: Retrieve an individual LifeMap timeline event by public ID with safe PHI DTO

path_parameters.name: event_id
path_parameters.description: Public UUID or opaque string ID of the event

endpoints.summary: Existing compatibility endpoint enhanced with bitemporal upper bounds and cursor pagination
Query capabilities, supported filters, and active feature flag state

profile_scoping.isolation_invariant: A user can only query events matching their owned or delegated profile
profile_scoping.audit_logging: Every timeline query writes an audit record with zero PHI payload
